messages.subject: Workers / Instances...
parts:
I have the basic plan.

I am getting significant traffic in flashes.
The main calculation routine takes about 10 seconds (which is acceptable).

I also know I can start more than 10 instances, but only 10 workers max.

How should I configure the "settings" for my app ?
Can I have more than 10 users running calculation routines in my app ?
Can I have more applications on my account and have each of them handle 10 users ?
What is difference between instance and worker ?
Thanks
Luke

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Workers / Instances...
parts:
The limit is 10 workers per instances. Keep in mind however, instances in a paid plan are limited to 8GB of memory. So you may not be able to run 10 workers (R processes) without running out of memory.

-Andy
